## PCIe Foundations

## MMIO and DMA

<div style="text-align: center;"><img src="imgs/img_in_image_box_514_352_1475_1146.jpg" alt="Image" width="48%" /></div>


MMIO: the CPU accesses a device's mapped register or memory window.

- DMA: the device accesses buffers in host memory.

<!-- page: 8 -->

## PCIe Foundations

Reads, Writes, and Completions

<div style="text-align: center;"><img src="imgs/img_in_image_box_196_404_1797_1117.jpg" alt="Image" width="80%" /></div>


Posted memory writes do not receive a successful transaction-layer Completion TLP.

- A read sends MRd and receives data in one or more CplD packets.

- Multiple outstanding requests can cover the round-trip delay.

## Noninterleaved example

Host base: 0x40000000

HPA: 0x40001240

Device base: 0

DPA = HPA - host base

= 0x1240
